Book Tickets Now View Showtimes Testimonial Udayan Cinema in Sheoraphuli offers one of the best movie-viewing experiences in the area. The theater stands out not only for its diverse seating options, including Gold, Silver, Royal Recliner, and luxurious sofas, but also for the comfort and ambiance it provides. Personally, I find the Royal Recliner to be the best choice, as it enhances the overall experience with its plush seating and perfect viewing angle. The staff at Udayan Cinema are notably polite, adding to the positive experience. They are always ready to assist, making the entire visit pleasant from start to finish. While the picture and audio quality may not be the absolute best compared to some high-end theaters, they are still good enough to ensure a satisfying movie experience. The quality is more than adequate for enjoying a quality time with friends or family. The cinema also offers a variety of food and beverages at affordable prices. The food is tasty and of good quality, although I believe the experience could be further enhanced by expanding the menu, especially by adding more beverage options. Booking tickets is convenient, with the option to use the BookMyShow app or purchase them offline at the theater. This flexibility ensures that everyone can easily secure their preferred seats. Overall, Udayan Cinema is a great place to enjoy movies, with its comfortable seating, friendly staff, and decent food options. With a few improvements, it could easily become the go-to spot for movie lovers in Sheoraphuli. Pritam Kumar This Theatre been situated in 1946.. A Very Old cinema hall in Hooghly district.. This Theatre is a Multiplex Chain .. & A very Good Cinema hall in Budget.. The Sound quality of the Theatre Was awesome Because they were Using 7.1 Dolby Surround sound.. The Picture Quality is Really very good.. I really enjoyed watching the movie in 3D.. Yes this is in Sheoraphuli So, From Kolkata the distance of the cinema is little out of the reach..But Definitely you will not regret here after watching any Cinema...You can feel the movie.. I Loved the staff behaviour too.. Definitely a Worth Watch movie Theater with a Very good multiplex Experience.. Definitely will suggest this Theatre to everyone.. Just go for it.. Bishal Sarkar This is a popular cinema hall near Sheoraphuli station, beside the G.T.Road. 1. Heritage & Location: It’s one of the older cinemas around (established 1946). Very conveniently located: near Sheoraphuli railway station and on G.T.Road - Makes it accessible. 2. Facilities after renovation / upgrades: One screen has been renovated to a plex model, with 2K projection, 3D silver screen. Air conditioning is present. Comfortable seating arrangements. Ticket prices are reasonable for what’s offered. 3. Show variety & experience: They screen both Bengali and Hindi films - Audience variety. The sound system and cozy environment in certain shows/screens is noteworthy. Jiraya De G. A Fantastic Cinema Experience with Great Games and Grub! I recently visited and was thoroughly impressed! The seating was incredibly comfortable and spotless, making for a truly enjoyable movie-watching experience. It's clear they prioritize cleanliness, which is always a huge plus. But what really sets this place apart is its accompanying cafe. It's more than just a snack bar; it's a vibrant hub with an excellent selection of indoor games, including classics like Ludo and Tic-Tac-Toe, and even an indoor football game! This adds such a fun, unique dimension to your visit, perfect for pre-movie entertainment or just hanging out. The ambiance is also a major highlight. It's beautifully designed and incredibly photogenic – you'll definitely want to snap some pictures! And despite the fantastic setting and entertainment, the food prices are surprisingly reasonable, offering great value. Overall, this cinema offers a top-notch cinema experience complemented by a fantastic cafe with games and a great atmosphere. Highly recommended! Soumya Neogi © 2025 UDAYAN CINEMA (P) LTD. pages.text: Skip to main content Udayan Cinema – Sheoraphuli | Tarakeshwar Sheoraphuli Sheoraphuli Entertaining since - 1946 Book Now Book Now Tarakeswar Entertaining Since - 2025 Book Now Book Now Tarakeswar Home About Us Gallery DPD Cafe Hooghly River Advertise with us Career with Us Contact Us Patron Feedback Home About Us Gallery DPD Cafe Hooghly River Advertise with us Career with Us Contact Us Patron Feedback Sheoraphuli Tarakeswar Home About Us Gallery DPD Cafe Hooghly River Advertise with us Career with Us Contact Us Patron Feedback Home About Us Gallery DPD Cafe Hooghly River Advertise with us Career with Us Contact Us Patron Feedback About Us Home About Us UDAYAN CINEMA (P) LTD’s journey began with the remarkable vision of Late Deb Prosad Daw, whose dream was to bring quality entertainment to the people of Sheoraphuli and beyond. With exceptional foresight for his time, he opened the gates of Udayan Cinema, Sheoraphuli on 27th December 1946—a full eight months before India’s Independence. What started as a courageous initiative quickly became a cultural landmark for the district of Hooghly.Today, Udayan Cinema is run by the third generation of the Daw Family of Rishra, who remain committed to carrying forward this legacy with pride, discipline, and a forward-looking approach. In an era when hundreds of single-screen cinemas across Bengal shuttered their doors, Udayan held firmly to its ground—adapting to changing times while staying true to its roots.On its 70th anniversary in December 2016, Udayan embraced a new chapter by transforming into a state-of-the-art 2-screen multiplex, blending modern amenities with the warmth and nostalgia that generations of patrons cherish. The journey of expansion continued with the opening of our first branch in Tarakeswar in August 2025, marking a significant milestone in our commitment to serve the entertainment needs of Hooghly district.Now, on the brink of entering its 8th decade, Udayan Cinema stands at a powerful intersection of heritage and ambition. We remain dedicated to offering an elevated cinematic experience—combining comfort, technology, hospitality, and a deep understanding of our community’s expectations.With a vision to grow into Hooghly’s very own homegrown multiplex chain, Udayan Cinema continues to honour its storied past while confidently shaping the entertainment landscape of tomorrow.UDAYAN CINEMA (P) LTD — Entertaining Since 1946.
